name: Project Kickoff Checklist
description: Everything you need to launch a project cleanly, from charter to kickoff meeting.

items.text: Review the approved project charter and objectives
Confirm the sponsor and decision-makers are committed
Verify the budget and funding are in place
Check that any required contracts are signed
items.note: Unsigned agreements are a common launch blocker.

items.text: Confirm the high-level timeline is realistic
Write clear, measurable goals for the project
Define what is in scope in plain language
List what is explicitly out of scope
Agree on the criteria for project success
Document key assumptions and constraints
Name the project manager and confirm their authority
Assign an owner to each major workstream
Clarify who approves decisions and deliverables
Confirm team members' availability and capacity
items.note: Check for competing projects before committing people.

items.text: Identify any external partners or vendors
List all stakeholders and their level of influence
Capture each stakeholder's expectations and concerns
Agree how and how often you will communicate updates
Set up shared tools and access for the team
Decide how decisions and changes will be approved
Send a clear agenda and goals ahead of time
Invite the right people and confirm attendance
Prepare a short, focused presentation or summary
Gather charter, scope, and timeline documents to share
Book the room or video link and test the setup
items.note: Test screen sharing before remote kickoffs.

sections.title: Run the Kickoff and Follow Up

items.text: Present the project purpose, goals, and scope
Walk through the timeline, milestones, and roles
Open the floor for questions and concerns
Agree on immediate next steps and owners
Send meeting notes and action items within a day
items.note: Fast follow-up keeps the momentum going.

faq.a: It is the official start of a project, where the team aligns on goals, scope, roles, and timeline. A good kickoff turns a plan on paper into a team ready to act.

faq.q: What should a kickoff meeting cover?
faq.a: Project purpose and goals, scope and out-of-scope items, roles and responsibilities, timeline and milestones, communication plan, and the immediate next steps for each person.

faq.q: Who should attend the kickoff meeting?
faq.a: The core delivery team, the project sponsor, and key stakeholders or client contacts. Keep it to people who own decisions or deliverables so the session stays focused.

faq.q: When should I run a project kickoff?
faq.a: Right after the project is approved and the basic plan exists, but before real work begins. Kicking off too early risks confusion; too late risks a messy, uncoordinated start.

faq.q: Can I print this project kickoff checklist?
faq.a: Yes. Download the printable PDF, use it to prepare before the meeting, and check off each item during the kickoff so nothing is missed at launch.
